column4: 我昨天看了一部关于动物的纪录片。
column5: Yesterday I watched a documentary about animals.
column6: 纪录片 is a documentary film: 一部纪录片, 拍纪录片 (to make a documentary).

column5: He is learning a new skill.
column6: 技能 is a practical skill you gain through practice: 学技能, 生活技能 (life skills), 工作技能 (job skills).

column4: 为了纪念他，学校建了一座新楼。
column5: To commemorate him, the school built a new building.
column6: 纪念 is to remember a person or an event with an action or an object: 纪念老师, 做纪念 (as a keepsake).

column4: 今天是我们结婚的纪念日。
column5: Today is our wedding anniversary.
column6: 纪念日 is a day for remembering something: 结婚纪念日 (a wedding anniversary). A birthday is 生日, not a 纪念日.

column4: 请计算一下这个月的花费。
column5: Please calculate this month's spending.
column6: 计算 is to work out a number: 计算价格 (to calculate the price), 计算时间 (to work out the time).

column5: He works at a computer company.
column6: 计算机 is the formal word for a computer. In speech people also say 电脑.

column5: This is my happiest memory.
column6: 记忆 is memory as a thing remembered (美好的记忆) and as the ability to remember (记忆很好). As a verb it is more formal than 记.

column3: to record; to write down (in a book)
column4: 书里记载了很多历史故事。
column5: The book records many historical stories.
column6: 记载 is to write down an event in a book or document: 有记载 (there is a record), 历史记载 (a historical record).

column4: 今天的节目请来了三位嘉宾。
column5: Today's programme has invited three guests.
column6: 嘉宾 is an honoured guest at an event or on a TV show. An ordinary guest is 客人.

column5: This shop sells all kinds of home appliances.
column6: 家电 is short for 家用电器: fridges, washing machines, TVs. 买家电 (to buy appliances).

column4: 这些食品是在工厂加工的。
column5: This food is processed in a factory.
column6: 加工 is to turn raw materials into a product: 加工食品 (processed food), 加工成 (to process into).

column5: Please heat up the milk.
column6: 加热 is to make something hot: 加热食物, 加热以后再吃 (to eat it after heating).

column4: 这次旅行加深了我们的友谊。
column5: This trip deepened our friendship.
column6: 加深 is to make something deeper: 加深了解 (to deepen understanding), 加深印象 (to leave a deeper impression).

column5: After crossing the bridge, the car accelerated.
column6: 加速 is to go faster or to make something faster: 加速前进, 加速发展 (to speed up development).

column5: At the weekend we do the housework together.
column6: 家务 is housework: 做家务 (to do housework), 家务事 (household chores).

column4: 合同里的甲方是一家大公司。
column5: The Party A in the contract is a big company.
column6: 甲 is the first of the ten Heavenly Stems, an old way of counting, and works like "A" or "first": 甲方 (Party A in a contract), 甲班 (Class A).

column4: 假如明天下雨，我们就不去。
column5: If it rains tomorrow, we will not go.
column6: 假如 is a written "if", often for imagining: 假如我是你 (if I were you). In speech people say 如果.

column3: measure word for planes and pianos; frame
column5: There is a plane in the sky.
column6: 架 counts machines with a frame: 一架飞机, 一架钢琴 (a piano). As a noun it is a frame or shelf, as in 书架 (bookshelf).

column5: He drove a car to the airport.
column6: 驾驶 is a formal word for driving a car or flying a plane: 驾驶汽车, 驾驶员 (a driver). In speech people say 开车.

column5: I got my driving licence yesterday.
column6: 驾照 is a driving licence: 考驾照 (to take the driving test), 拿驾照 (to get a licence).

column5: This painting is very valuable.
column6: 价值 is how much something is worth: 有价值 (valuable), 价值很大 (of great value).

column5: Life in the mountains is very hard.
column6: 艰苦 is for hard living or working conditions: 艰苦的环境 (a harsh environment), 艰苦的工作.

column5: She is a very strong person.
column6: 坚强 is inner strength when things are hard: 坚强的人, 坚强地活下去 (to live on bravely).

column4: 他在路上捡到了一个钱包。
column5: He found a wallet on the road.
column6: 捡 is to pick something up from the ground: 捡起来 (to pick up), 捡到 (to find by chance).

column5: I want to cut my hair.
column6: 剪 is to cut with scissors: 剪头发 (to get a haircut), 剪纸 (paper cutting).

column5: Please give me the scissors.
column6: 剪刀 is a pair of scissors. The measure word is 把: 一把剪刀.

column4: 运动是最好的减肥办法。
column5: Exercise is the best way to lose weight.
column6: 减肥 is to lose weight on purpose. It is a verb plus object, so it splits: 减了肥, 想减肥.

column5: He is writing his own CV.
column6: 简历 is a short summary of your study and work: 写简历, 发简历 (to send a CV), 个人简历.

column4: 这里的风景简直太美了。
column5: The scenery here is simply too beautiful.
column6: 简直 stresses that something is almost unbelievable: 简直太好了 (simply wonderful), 简直不敢相信 (simply cannot believe it).

column4: 他们在河边建了一座桥。
column5: They built a bridge by the river.
column6: 建 is to build or set up: 建房子, 建桥, 建学校. It is also in 建立, 建设, 建造, 建筑.

column5: Please press this key.
column6: 键 is a key you press, such as on a keyboard or a phone: 按键, 键盘. A key that opens a lock is 钥匙.

column5: The weather is gradually getting cold.
column6: 渐渐 means slowly and step by step. It is often followed by 了 to show a change: 渐渐好了, 渐渐明白了.

column4: 他们建立了新的合作关系。
column5: They have built a new working relationship.
column6: 建立 is to set up something lasting: 建立公司, 建立关系 (to build a relationship). 建 is for a building; 建立 is for organisations and relations.

column5: He is typing on the keyboard.
column6: 键盘 is the keyboard of a computer or a piano: 电脑键盘, 手机键盘.

column5: The country is building new cities.
column6: 建设 is large-scale building of a country, a city or a system: 城市建设, 建设国家. 建 is for a single thing such as a house.

column4: 他们用了两年建造这座桥。
column5: They took two years to build this bridge.
column6: 建造 is to build a large thing such as a bridge, a house or a ship: 建造房子, 建造大桥.

column4: 这个城市的建筑很特别。
column5: The buildings of this city are very special.
column6: 建筑 is a building (一座建筑) and the art of building (建筑师, an architect). It is also a verb: 建筑铁路 (to build a railway).

column5: I waited for nearly an hour.
column6: 将近 means "almost" for a quantity and comes before the number: 将近一个小时 (nearly an hour), 将近十年 (nearly ten years).

column5: The headmaster is giving a speech at the meeting.
column6: 讲话 is to speak, usually to a group and formally: 领导的讲话 (the leader's speech). It is a verb plus object, so it splits: 讲了话.

column5: He is very particular about his food.
column6: 讲究 is to pay close attention to details: 讲究卫生 (to pay attention to hygiene). As an adjective it means "exquisite": 很讲究的房子.

column5: The teacher rewarded him with a book.
column6: 奖励 is to give a prize or a reward for good work: 奖励学生, 得到奖励 (to receive a reward). It is also a noun.

column5: He told his own story.
column6: 讲述 is to tell a story or an experience in detail: 讲述故事, 讲述经历. It is more formal than 讲.

column5: There is a history lecture today.
column6: 讲座 is a talk or lecture, often open to the public: 听讲座 (to attend a lecture), 开讲座 (to give a lecture).

column5: This region has a lot of rainfall.
column6: 降水 is rain, snow and any water falling from the sky. It is a written word; in speech people say 下雨.

column5: He waters the flowers every day.
column6: 浇 is to pour liquid onto something: 浇花, 浇水 (to water plants).

column5: They exchanged phone numbers.
column6: 交换 is to swap something between two sides: 交换礼物 (to exchange gifts), 交换意见 (to exchange views).

column3: to associate with; to have contact
column4: 他很喜欢和不同的人交往。
column5: He likes to associate with different kinds of people.
column6: 交往 is to spend time with other people: 和……交往. For two people it can also mean they are dating: 他们交往了五年.

column4: 他们在网上做了一笔交易。
column5: They made a deal online.
column6: 交易 is buying and selling: 做交易 (to do a deal), 网上交易 (online trading). It is also a verb.

column5: I heard footsteps.
column6: 脚步 is the movement of your feet: 脚步声 (the sound of footsteps), 加快脚步 (to quicken one's steps).

column4: 我们要从不同的角度想问题。
column5: We need to look at problems from different angles.
column6: 角度 is the angle of a shape (角度很大) and a point of view: 从……角度看 (seen from the angle of …).

column5: This year's weather is rather cold.
column6: 较 is a written "rather": 较好 (fairly good), 较大 (comparatively big). As a preposition it compares, like 比.

column5: This set of teaching materials is very suitable for students.
column6: 教材 is a textbook or any material used for teaching: 汉语教材, 选教材 (to choose a textbook).

column5: He meets many people every day.
column6: 接触 is to come into contact with people or things: 接触新事物 (to come across new things). It is general contact, not touching with the hand.

column5: He is responsible for receiving guests.
column6: 接待 is to welcome and look after guests or visitors: 接待客人. It is more formal than 欢迎.

column4: 工作已经到了最后阶段。
column5: The work has reached the final stage.
column6: 阶段 is one stage in a process: 第一阶段 (the first stage), 最后阶段 (the final stage).

column3: to approach; to be close to
column5: The train is approaching the station.
column6: 接近 is to get close in space, time or number: 接近成功 (close to success), 接近十二点 (close to twelve o'clock).

column4: 我已经接收了你的邮件。
column5: I have already received your email.
column6: 接收 is to take in something sent to you: 接收邮件, 接收信息. 接受 (to accept) is for an idea or a gift.

column5: I cannot tie this knot.
column6: 结 is mostly read jié, but it is read jiē when it means to bear fruit (结果实). It means to tie (打结, a knot), to form, and it is in 结婚 and 结束.

column4: 这座房子的结构很特别。
column5: The structure of this house is very special.
column6: 结构 is how the parts of something fit together: 句子的结构 (sentence structure), 结构合理 (the structure is sensible).

column4: 这家饭馆把中餐和西餐结合起来。
column5: This restaurant combines Chinese and Western food.
column6: 结合 is to join two things so they work together: 把 A 和 B 结合起来 (to combine A and B).

column5: What conclusion did you reach?
column6: 结论 is the final result of thinking or research: 得出结论 (to reach a conclusion), 下结论 (to draw a conclusion).

column5: Taking the underground can save time.
column6: 节省 is to use less money, time or things: 节省时间, 节省用水 (to save water). 省 is the shorter everyday word.

column4: 下一届比赛在明年举行。
column5: The next session of the competition will be held next year.
column6: 届 counts regular events and classes: 第一届 (the first session), 本届 (this session), 这一届学生 (this year's class).

column5: Today's weather is very good.
column6: 今日 is a written word for 今天, used in news and on signs: 今日新闻 (today's news). In speech people say 今天.

column5: These trousers are too tight.
column6: 紧 means "tight" (太紧了), "tense" or "short of time" (时间很紧) and "to tighten" (关紧).

column5: This is an urgent phone call.
column6: 紧急 is for a situation that needs action at once: 紧急情况 (an emergency), 紧急电话 (an emergency call).

column5: Please reply to me as soon as possible.
column6: 尽快 is "as quickly as you can": 尽快完成 (to finish as soon as possible). 尽 is read jǐn here.

column5: Please come as early as possible.
column6: 尽量 is "as much as possible": 尽量多吃 (to eat as much as possible), 尽量不要 (to try not to). 尽 is read jǐn here.

column4: 两个公司的关系很紧密。
column5: The relationship between the two companies is very close.
column6: 紧密 is for a very close link or tight fit: 联系紧密 (closely connected), 紧密合作 (to cooperate closely).

column5: He is very careful in what he does.
column6: 谨慎 is careful so as to avoid mistakes: 态度谨慎 (a careful attitude). 小心 is everyday "be careful"; 谨慎 describes a careful nature.

column5: Your Chinese is making fast progress.
column6: 进步 is to make progress: 有进步, 进步很大 (to make great progress). It is also a noun.

column5: This is the history of modern China.
column6: 近代 is the period not long before the present. In Chinese history it starts around the middle of the 1800s. 古代 is ancient times.

column4: 这些水果是从国外进口的。
column5: These fruits are imported from abroad.
column6: 进口 is to bring goods in from another country: 进口汽车 (imported cars). The opposite is 出口 (to export).

column5: We have already done our best.
column6: 尽力 is to use all your strength: 尽力帮助 (to help as much as one can). 尽 is read jìn here.

column4: 近年来，这里的变化很大。
column5: In recent years, the changes here have been great.
column6: 近年来 means "in recent years" and usually starts the sentence: 近年来，这座城市发展得很快.

column5: The weather has been good recently.
column6: 近期 means the recent past or the near future, depending on the sentence: 近期的天气 (recent weather), 近期会有变化 (changes are coming soon).
